# Stack

One-dimensional layout

## Overview

- **Category**: layout
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: Stack

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { Stack } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<Stack spacing={2}>
  <Paper>Item 1</Paper>
  <Paper>Item 2</Paper>
</Stack>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<Stack spacing={2}>
  <Paper>Item 1</Paper>
  <Paper>Item 2</Paper>
</Stack>
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's Stack.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:

- [MUI Stack Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/stack/)
